reviews.text: A fantastic casual dungeon crawler. A great pick for all gamers, with elements akin to several known titles. Automation elements like Forager, combat similar in feel to Enter the Gungeon (but with fewer bullets), and a UI that's easy to understand. Not a terribly long game, and that's okay. Includes a difficulty selector and a Reset Progress option. Genuinely able to run perfectly on any computer made in the last 20 years. Roguelike is not a tag I would use to describe this game, as roguelikes involve losing progress on defeat. This game only causes the gold received in the dungeon to be lost, items are kept. Plan your automation well, as the end-game gear requires a lot of the beginning resources!

Cute and full of action! Free little animals from capture (kinda like old sonic ) and have them help you out by either Crafting, Fetching resources , or managing your inventory for you! Combat is pretty Simple Sword for attacking and Shield to raise health, The dodge animation is so cute seeing little kitty get ready to roll. Progression is pretty straight forward. Each cave has so many rooms, Each room has animals to free and loot to collect as well as a boss at the end. Expect some grind though since you will need ALLOT of resources to craft better gear and such. Luckily you can switch difficulty whenever and you will find plenty of power ups to help along the way. If you want a chill and cute kitty game with some action and gear crafting /resource farming then give this one a try

Fun small game! Has automation and crafting elements but a rather linear playthrough. If you are heavily into automation and crafting this might not be for you. If you want to play a cat slashing robots with a sword to rescue animals, this is perfect! I finished the game within 6.5h, obviously that could vary a bit depending on your playstyle. For me it was worth the money and I enjoyed seeing how it evolved from the early demos and devlogs.

A short, cute progression roguelite with some crafting elements. You head into a dungeon and collect animals to help gather resources, allowing you to upgrade your gear before rinsing and repeating. My only critique is that I expected more unique mechanics from the level bosses. Unfortunately, they all follow the same pattern, just with increased health and damage. Seeing the end-game boss convinced me that the other bosses could have had different attack patterns too. Overall, though, it's a very enjoyable game that I had a lot of fun with
Super cute game! Combat was really satisfying. Simple but really charming sprites and animations. The dash attack felt really good to pull off :3 Peak cat butt wiggle animation

I love this little game. The combat is simple enough to not be daunting but still fun to aim those dashes and time the dash-strikes. The crafting automation with all the little animal buddy helpers is a neat concept and I think I have as much fun trying to set that up well as I do in the combat sections. And of course, it's just fun to be a cat helping rescue other captured critters from the nasty robots.

I'm in love! I've always wanted a game where the animals aren't foes/assets meant for us to hunt/kill/farm. All the critters are adorable, and their greetings and little motivational phrases are such a lovely addition! It feels fair that we have to maintain their affection level, given we're putting them to work. Combat feels challenging enough, I like the boons and aids during the battles. All in all, 10/10! The dev has a YouTube channel, that's how I found out about the game, I super recommend checking it out, she has videos on the development of the game!
